# Misbah — مصباح

## About
Misbah is a public directory for independent teachers of Quran, Arabic, and Islamic Studies.

## Purpose
- Help students find qualified independent teachers
- Provide teachers with visibility without platform intermediation
- Direct contact between teachers and students

## What Misbah Is
- A public directory (like Yellow Pages for teachers)
- SEO-first for discoverability
- Annual subscription model

## What Misbah Is NOT
- Not an academy
- Not a marketplace with transactions
- Not a booking platform
- Not an employer

## Available Pages
- / — Home page with overview
- /directory — Browse all active teachers
- /teachers/[id] — Individual teacher profiles
- /onboarding — Teacher registration (requires auth)
- /admin — Admin dashboard (protected)

## API
No public API. All data is displayed on public pages.

## Contact
For inquiries: [Website contact information]

## Language
Content available in Arabic and English.
